name: Parameters.galOfPlace_placeOfInt_zeta
summary: galOfPlace(P, s)(v)(ζ(P, s)) = ζ(P, s)^{class of v}, the class of placeOfInt(P, s, ν) is ν mod N₁(P, s), and ζ(P, s) has order N₁(P, s).

steps.claim: galOfPlace(P, s)(placeOfInt(P, s, ν))(ζ(P, s)) = ζ(P, s)^a with a the representative of the class of ν mod N₁(P, s) (`galOfPlace_zeta`, `placeClass_placeOfInt`); a = ν − N₁(P, s)⌊ν/N₁(P, s)⌋ and ζ(P, s)^{N₁(P, s)} = 1, so ζ(P, s)^a = ζ(P, s)^ν.
steps.lean:
P.galOfPlace s (P.placeOfInt s ν) (P.ζ s) = P.ζ s ^ ν := by simp [galOfPlace_zeta,
  placeClass_placeOfInt h, ← zpow_natCast, coe_intCast, Int.emod_def, zpow_sub₀,
  isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.ne_zero out, (isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.zpow_eq_one_iff_dvd _).2]
